provenance: Tibet 6 (world 2, level 5, menu 6) normal exit 46,7; control-only on the exact S700 core. Start values: weaponTier 2 (Tibet 1-6 start with the hook granted by choosing Tibet on the seal; this stage itself holds the ice hammer, which the route obtains), maxHealth 4 (no armor), lives 12 (campaign value used by the old routes), diamonds/redDiamonds 0 (the magic lock counts diamonds collected in this stage). Route: walk east collecting 2 diamonds (13,6 12,6), through the snow/brick passage to checkpoint 1 (28,10); step on the riddle trigger 30,10 (gate 29,10 closes, hint USE THE SWITCH!), pass the shooters to the silver key chest 32,16; north through the plate room to checkpoint 2 (36,5) and row 3; get frozen by the row-4 freeze beam at 31,4 (no fall), break free and pass during the 40-frame invulnerability; use the switch 26,4 so the bridge 22-25,6 becomes walkable; west over the bridge to the start area, silver lock 5,11 (gate 5,12), checkpoint 3 (6,12), silver key chest 6,17 (row-16 beam passed the same way), silver lock 8,13 (gate 8,14), corridor and ice-creature room to checkpoint 4 (19,26). Walk over the snow at 20,21 so the freeze emitter 20,19-20 drops to 20,22-23; push it left from 21,23 so its beam sweeps row 22 and freezes the guard 22,22; hook it back right (beam faces left again); push the frozen guard east until it drops at 27,23; open the ICE HAMMER chest 32,22 (item dialogue dismissed with the action key; weaponTier 8). Freeze guard 37,23 and hook-pull it twice into the pit 34,24; checkpoint 5 (39,23); freeze guard 41,23 and push it into the pit 42,24. Climb the east column, letting the ceiling traps 42,17 44,15 42,9 41,9 fall beside the hero, collecting 4 diamonds; freeze the top enemy of shaft 37 (the falling ice crushes the two below) and open the diamond chests 36,17 38,17. Through the plate room and row 3, beam passed again at 31,4, 5 diamonds at 30-33,6-7, over the bridge; freeze the top enemy of shaft 27 and open the chests 26,17 28,17 (51 diamonds; the magic diamond lock 45,7 opens at 40). Back over the bridge; crossing the beam upward at 30,4 the frozen hero falls to 30,7 (1 damage); in the exit room freeze the enemy 40,4 and push it so it drops onto the plate 41,7 (gate 44,7 opens); walk out through 44-46,7. 3 health left, 0 resets.
